title: introduce-kms-region-whitelist-and-residency-assertion-translator
author: Marina Kline
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require per-tenant KMS usage constraints and auditable evidence that keys were selected only from an approved region whitelist. This PR introduces a compact KMS region whitelist enforcement piece and a residency assertion translator that synthesizes a tamper-evident audit header for downstream observers. High-level changes: 1) pkg/kms/whitelist: a KMSKeyWhitelist service that validates requested CMK locations against tenant-configured allowed regions; it exposes a pluggable verifier used by both hosted and private runtimes. 2) pkg/audit/residency_translator: middleware that consumes the request context and KMS decision and emits X-Redwood-Residency-Assertion header (base64 of signed assertion) and a hashed short form X-Redwood-Residency-Hash used for high-volume logs. 3) rbac/v2: an optional mapping rule that ties operator/service-account roles to allowed region sets; the mapper is behind a feature flag to preserve backward compatibility. 4) helm/private values: new toggles and defaults to turn on whitelist enforcement in Private installs and to configure signing key references (KMS or HSM). 5) integration tests and e2e test harness updates to assert header presence and to simulate multi-region key selection. Rollout plan: feature-gated by config.private.kms.regionWhitelist.enabled and config.runtime.residencyAssertion.enabled defaulting to false; staging rollout for 48 hours with audit-only mode (enforce=false but assert header emitted) before turning enforcement on. Security and compliance notes: assertion header contains tenant id, key id, chosen region, verifier fingerprint and timestamp; the header is HMAC-signed by the service signing key (configurable) to avoid leaking plaintext keys. Migration notes: when enforcement is enabled, requests attempting to use a KMS key outside tenant whitelist will be rejected with 403 KMS_REGION_NOT_ALLOWED and an audit entry. Backward compatibility: when gate disabled the runtime behaves as today. Testing: unit tests for whitelist logic (edge cases for wildcard region lists and operator overrides), integration tests for header round-trip and log ingestion; manual privacy review performed by SEC team. Checklist: [x] design doc in Linear ENG-1428 [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] security review approval SEC-33 [x] helm config docs updated. Related work: builds on earlier residency-audit work but takes a different approach by producing a signed assertion header for downstream immutable logging systems.

review_conversation: Aamir Patel: Please add a defensive fallback when the signing key is not available in the private installer; we shouldn't fail open. Marina: Added signing fallback to use local ephemeral HMAC when explicit signing key reference missing and documented risk.

Sofia Ruiz: Can we avoid leaking tenant region lists in logs? Suggest hashing the region list in the audit payload. Marina: We now only include chosen region plaintext and hashed bucket for allowed set; updated translator accordingly.

Gina Hollingsworth: Request more coverage for wildcard region entries and operator-override path. Marina: Added table-driven tests covering wildcard and explicit operator allowlist; also added a small e2e scenario demonstrating operator-override approval flow.
Compliance (SEC): Approved with one follow-up to rotate signing keys on a 90-day cadence; ops playbook entry added.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky test fixed on rerun)
release_notes: Added configurable tenant KMS region whitelist and optional residency assertion headers. A new helm flag enables audit-only mode so teams can validate effects before enforcement. When enforcement is enabled, requests using keys outside the tenant whitelist will be rejected with 403. Ops: update private values to set signing key reference or fallback will be used.
risk_assessment: Medium: introduces enforcement that can block deployments if misconfigured; mitigated via audit-only mode and feature gate. Requires ops to provision a signing key for assertions.
rollout_plan: 1) enable audit-only mode in staging for 48h 2) validate logs and assertion headers 3) enable enforcement in staging 4) gradual rollout to prod with a canary tenant pool 5) monitor audit and error rate dashboards for 72h
notes_for_ops: To enable enforcement set private.kms.regionWhitelist.enabled=true and provide signing.keyRef. For air-gapped installs use local HSM path. Run scripts/signing_key_rotator.sh to rotate assertion signing keys per playbook.
